PGIM India Global Select Real Estate Securities FoF(G)-Direct Plan is a part of PGIM India Asset Management Private Limited, it was incepted on 03 Dec 2021. This fund is managed by Anandha Padmanabhan Anjeneyan and Sharma Vivek. It is a Fund of Fund type of fund.

The current NAV of PGIM India Global Select Real Estate Securities FoF(G)-Direct Plan is ₹13.26 (as of 25 Sep 2026).

The minimum SIP amount for PGIM India Global Select Real Estate Securities FoF(G)-Direct Plan is ₹1000.

The expense ratio of PGIM India Global Select Real Estate Securities FoF(G)-Direct Plan is 1.28%.
